"""Generate six continuous, pressure-modulated calligraphic strokes on the fixed sheet."""
import json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline,PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def curve(p,step=.20):
 p=np.asarray(p,float);t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1),.3))]
 tt=np.linspace(0,t[-1],max(2,int(t[-1]/.06)+1))
 fine=np.c_[CubicSpline(t,p[:,:2],bc_type='natural')(tt),PchipInterpolator(t,p[:,2])(tt)]
 d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(fine,axis=0),axis=1))]
 u=np.linspace(0,d[-1],int(np.ceil(d[-1]/step))+1)
 return np.c_[[np.interp(u,d,fine[:,i]) for i in range(3)]].T

def main():
 inp=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else BASE/'fitted.json';ps=json.load(open(inp))
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start();tm=time.time()
 def move(xyz,speed=.09,settle=8):return p['move_tip'](xyz,speed=speed,settle=settle)
 def world(q):return np.array([*s.geo.mm_to_world(q[0],q[1]),.020-q[2]/1000])
 for i,pts in enumerate(ps):
  move([*s.tip_pose()[0][:2],.055]);move([-.1,.15,.055]);move([-.1,.15,.026],.04);move([-.1,.15,.055])
  q=curve(pts);start=world(q[0]);direction=world(q[1])-start;direction[2]=0;direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
  move(start-direction*.004+[0,0,.012]);move(start+[0,0,.003],.02)
  # Follow the desired tip curve slowly. Feed forward one controller-lag interval.
  data=np.array([world(a) for a in q]); data=np.vstack([start+[0,0,.003],data,data[-1]+[0,0,.003]])
  # densify entry and exit independently
  entry=np.linspace(data[0],data[1],16)[:-1];end=np.linspace(data[-2],data[-1],16)[1:]
  data=np.vstack([entry,data[1:-1],end])
  for j,point in enumerate(data):
   vel=(data[min(j+1,len(data)-1)]-data[max(j-1,0)])/2
   cmd=point+vel*1.6
   joints,ok,err=s.ik(cmd)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,j,err))
   s.step(joints)
  p['hold'](8);move([*s.tip_pose()[0][:2],.055],.04)
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE/f'canvas{i}.png')
  print('stroke',i,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',time.time()-tm,flush=True)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,BASE/'trajectory.npz')
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE/'canvas.png')
 np.savez_compressed(BASE/'realized.npz',**{f's{i}':st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes()) if st['sheet']=='main' and st['inked']})
 metrics=s.status();print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2),flush=True);json.dump(metrics,open(BASE/'metrics.json','w'),indent=2)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
